title: BLUE LOCK -EPISODE NAGI-
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A spin-off of Blue Lock told from the view of Seishiro Nagi, an apathetic high schooler who finds everything a pain. Wealthy classmate Reo Mikage, determined to win the World Cup and escape his family's shadow, spots Nagi's talent and recruits him. The two enter Blue Lock, a training program meant to find Japan's single best striker, where losers are expelled from Japanese soccer for good.
life_message: Talent wakes up through a partner's belief and a goal worth chasing, though ambition can strain even close friendships.
